'''Orocco''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Orocco system/Legends|Orocco system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
Ruled by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Arturo]], in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] it was occupied by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], it was the site of the [[Battle of Orocco]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
